title: 300 Relax Puzzles
description: Unwind with a huge collection of crisp tactile puzzle stages—slide directional blocks, untangle neat geometric paths, and pop clean clears at your own pace.
controls: Tap unobstructed arrows and pieces to clear the board step by step across hundreds of handcrafted stages.

zh-CN.title: 全面解压 300 关
zh-CN.description: 300 关海量轻解压消除合集：每一关都是精致清爽的几何逻辑谜题，顺着方向逐一弹出清空，随时随地放空大脑。
zh-CN.controls: 点击无阻挡的方向块依次移出棋盘，按顺序拆解所有关卡布局。
